pages.text: Develop chaos-processing equipment in recipe order and check energy requirements before connecting it. Use the quests and JEI to separate equipment projects from material-processing projects.

The Draconic Reactor is an optional UV undertaking. Study its containment and control requirements before loading fuel. Give it a dedicated installation and verify the controls before commissioning it.$(br2)Ready for the final boss: your equipment is configured, charged and tested, and the factory can replenish the supplies behind it.
